heritage.title: Drawing from the Kingdom’s rich maritime heritage

items.question: What courses are available at the Academy?
items.answer: The Academy runs RYA-accredited sailing, powerboating and other watersports courses for children and adults, at every skill level.

items.question: Do I need prior experience to join a course?
items.answer: No. Our beginner courses start from scratch, and there are courses for every level after that.

items.question: How can I make a reservation at The Jeddah EDITION?
items.answer: You can book directly on The Jeddah EDITION’s website, or contact us and our team will help you with your booking.

items.question: What amenities are available at the hotel?
items.answer: The hotel has 63 luxury rooms, a spa, a gym and restaurants by a renowned chef.

items.question: What size yachts can the Marina accommodate?
items.answer: The Marina welcomes yachts and superyachts of up to 120 metres.

items.question: What services are available at the Marina?
items.answer: Berth holders enjoy high-speed Wi-Fi, round-the-clock security, fuelling and a personal concierge service.

items.question: How can I join the Yacht Club?
items.answer: Send us a message through the contact form. Our team will share the membership details and can arrange a tour of the Marina.

items.question: What benefits come with Yacht Club membership?
items.answer: Members are invited to exclusive events and get priority booking at the hotel and Marina, discounts at the restaurants and access to Academy courses.

hero.title: The Yacht Club
hero.text: Join the Yacht Club and step into our iconic sail-and-boom-shaped clubhouse, standing proudly on the Jeddah Waterfront.
hero.intro: Home to a myriad of exceptional experiences, it’s your place to explore new adventures or find retreat – in peaceful solitude or among a community of like-minded people.
hero.imageAlt: The Yacht Club and marina at dusk

features.title: Step into a realm of private sanctuaries
features.text: Network over breathtaking views of the Red Sea and Jeddah skyline at {highlight}. Relax at the Cigar Lounge, complete with a curated selection of fine cigars and private humidors. For dining, try Marina Social, led by Michelin-starred chef Jason Atherton, offering a Mediterranean culinary journey with live entertainment and waterfront views.
features.imageAlt: Lounge chairs by the windows overlooking the Red Sea

features.title: Enjoy priority hotel & berth bookings
features.text: Enjoy priority access to marina berthing and luxury hotel accommodations. With 95 berths accommodating yachts up to 120 meters, the marina offers top-tier docking facilities, ensuring a hassle-free experience for yacht owners. Members also receive priority bookings at the club’s luxury hotel, featuring 63 elegantly designed rooms.
features.imageAlt: Yachts moored in front of the Yacht Club

features.title: Access private concierge services
features.text: As a member, your dedicated Guest Relations Officer will provide bespoke services tailored to your unique lifestyle, handling all arrangements and queries. You also enjoy personalized shopping and dining experiences, along with priority access through complimentary valet and members-only parking areas.
features.imageAlt: A dish being served at a dining table

features.title: Network with business leaders & yachting enthusiasts
features.text: Gain access to a unique network of like-minded professionals from the worlds of business, luxury, and yachting. Connect over shared passions at intimate social events, foster collaborations in our state-of-the-art boardrooms, and host gatherings on the Terrace.
features.imageAlt: A brass telescope in the club lounge

hero.title: JYC Marina
hero.text: As the premier international port on Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea coast, Jeddah Yacht Club & Marina offers 5-star docking facilities and a range of modern amenities, ensuring your yachting journey is seamless and worry-free.
hero.intro: Home to a myriad of exceptional experiences, it’s your place to explore new adventures or find retreat – in peaceful solitude or among a community of like-minded people.

berth.title: Berth yachts & superyachts
berth.text: Berth yachts up to 120 meters. Each berth is equipped with a 50/60Hz power supply, freshwater, and blackwater removal systems, and comprehensive maintenance services are available to keep vessels in top condition.
berth.imageAlt: The Yacht Club's sail-shaped clubhouse seen from the water

dining.title: Experience Jeddah’s culinary excellence
dining.text: Step off your yacht and immerse yourself on the Boardwalk, a vibrant waterfront promenade that perfectly encircles the Marina. Featuring an array of luxury international and Arabian restaurants, the Boardwalk also offers an exceptional selection of retail venues.
dining.imageAlt: A restaurant front on the Boardwalk

items: 24/7 top-tier security measures for peace of mind
Recognized Port of Entry with customs and immigration services
Hassle-free crew visa processing through the EBHAR e-portal

items.question: What are the navigation reference points for entrance into Jeddah Yacht Club & Marina?
items.answer: The reference point for the marina entrance is latitude 21°38'02" N, longitude 39°05'30" E.

items.question: Are there any specific contact details or channels to reach out to Jeddah Yacht Club & Marina?
items.answer: You can contact the marina on VHF channel 17 or 76, using the call sign “JYC Control”.

items.question: Are there any restrictions on boat size allowed at The Marina?
items.answer: The Marina welcomes vessels of up to 120 meters, with pontoon finger, Mediterranean moor and alongside berthing options.

items.question: What are the current check-in and check-out procedures?
items.answer: Local check-in and check-out are streamlined, with no extra stops along the way. International arrivals and departures go through the Port of Entry and Exit service, arranged through a boat agent whose office is about a two-minute buggy ride from the marina.

items.question: What types of visitor berthing options are available at Jeddah Yacht Club & Marina?
items.answer: Visitors can berth to pick up or drop off guests, to check out before an international voyage, or to dock and dine for up to four hours. Berths are also available by the day, month or year.

items.question: How much does berthing cost?
items.answer: Berthing rates depend on the size of your vessel and the length of your stay. Contact the marina team below and we’ll send you a quote.

items.question: What fuel is available at JYC Marina?
items.answer: The on-site fuel station offers Gas 95 and diesel. International bunkers can be arranged with prior notice.

items.question: What does 24/7 access mean?
items.answer: You can enter or leave the marina at any time, and our team is on hand around the clock, every day of the year.

items.question: What security measures are in place to ensure the safety of boats in the marina?
items.answer: Dock staff trained in emergency response are on duty 24/7, entry to the marina is gated, and the whole area is covered by an extensive CCTV network.

items.question: What specific documents are required when requesting a berth in the marina?
items.answer: For annual berthing you will need the owner’s ID; company registration documents if the vessel is owned by a company; the vessel registration (permanent for KSA); a navigation permit (KSA-registered or international, arranged through an agent); and proof of insurance with third-party cover of at least USD 1,000,000.

hero.title: The Academy
hero.text: Train at the Academy, the largest RYA-accredited training facility in the Kingdom. As a driving force in watersports, the Academy is dedicated to nurturing the next generation of sailing enthusiasts in the region.

beacon.title: A Beacon For Maritime Education
beacon.text: In partnership with the Saudi Sailing Federation, the Academy plays a pivotal role in expanding the reach of watersports in the Kingdom. Together, we have launched groundbreaking programs like Sailability, the first sailing program for people with disabilities.
beacon.imageAlt: Young sailors in front of the Academy building

items.title: Youth Courses
items.text: Enhance your sailing skills with our RYA courses for all ages and levels, guided by expert coaches to support beginners and aspiring competitors alike.
items.imageAlt: Young sailors with their coach on a dinghy

items.title: Adult sailing
items.text: Learn to sail or take your skills further with RYA dinghy and keelboat courses for adults, from your very first time on the water to advanced sailing.
items.imageAlt: Sailors smiling on a small sailing boat

items.title: Powerboats
items.text: Master powerboating with our RYA courses, designed for watersports enthusiasts and professionals seeking qualifications. Learn essential skills for confident and competent powerboat handling.
items.imageAlt: Kayaks in front of the Yacht Club at sunset

items.title: Shore-Based
items.text: JYC Academy is training the next generation of maritime professionals in Saudi Arabia with RYA-recognized courses, including First Aid, Navigation, Day Skipper, Seamanship, Yacht Master, and VHF training.
items.imageAlt: An instructor speaking to a group on the marina

items.title: Lifeguard training
items.text: Prioritizing water safety, we offer the top-rated Ellis & Associates International Lifeguard Training Program™ (ILTP®).
items.imageAlt: The deck of a yacht with a dining table

items.title: Corporate & Schools
items.text: Our modern fleet and experienced instructors accommodate large groups, from school classes to corporate team-building events.
